definitions.full: H1773. deyo דְּיוֺ noun masculine ink (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic דְּיוּתָא ; Arabic inkbottle, inkhorn ; Ges-Dietr Fl NHWB i. 41 derived from √ דוה in assumed sense of slowly flowing ; Fl compare Arabic thin skin on surface of milk , compare also Ol § 178 g ), בַּדְּי֑וֺ עַלהַֿסֵּפֶר כֹּתֵב וַאֲנִי Jer 36:18 , compare Lag Ges. Abh. 216 . — On erasable quality of Hebrew ink compare RS OTJC, 400 f. ed. 2, 71; see further L. Löw Graphische Requisiten etc. bel den Juden, 1870, i. 145 ff .
